population_source.match_policy: For a single-exon deletion, any gnomAD-SV deletion that spans the complete coding interval of that exon is a population match. Exact breakpoint equality is not required. PASS and filtered matches are both retained; a filtered match prevents an absence conclusion.
population_source.quality_policy: Only an exon with a reproducibly derived GRCh37 interval and no matching PASS or filtered deletion can establish population absence.

pm2_policy.source: ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1/2 VCEP v1.2 Appendix G
